_about: CRL metadata-annotation registry — the canonical tag vocabulary, value shapes, cardinality, and lifecycle for `@tag` annotations carried on `- meta is `@tag: <body>`.` lines. Consumed by the Validator; human companion is metadata-model.md in this folder.
statusNote: v0.3.4 (#212 step 4b): the review-FLAG tags LEFT this registry — flags now live as medical-validation/flags/<id>.json store records (vocabulary in flags/flagVocab.ts). REMOVED: the 5 flag:true tags, flagModel, the flag validatorRules, and the flag clause of reRunReplaceRule; @gap-filed (a non-flag pointer) stays. The .crl-meta open-flag warning is gone — the MV gate now reads the flag store, not .crl meta. v0.3.3 (KE #205): `@validation-concern` gains an OPTIONAL `; kind` triage enum (underspecified/narrative-error/intent-divergence/context-conflict — the KE-delivered validation-issue taxonomy; gate/emit-neutral) + a note that a `; key` on a validation-concern is the #203 GAP-3 occurrence address, not a re-add-guard hash. Core vocabulary stable (two design-review rounds). v0.2.0 adds the review-flag tags per KE #203 (additive; two further design-review rounds — disc 220). v0.3.0 (Todo 5): status-aware CQL emit — the 4 flag tags + `@ke-feedback` gain `emit.suppressWhenStatus:[resolved]`; the flags flip `emit.cql:true` + `emit.cqlScopes:[concept]`. v0.3.1 (Todo 6): the 4 flag tags gain an OPTIONAL `ref` field (the tracker-issue link; `@gap-filed`'s ref stays required). v0.3.2 (Piece 1, #203): adds the `category:validation` flag `@validation-concern` (CRL-faithful-to-CUSTOMER-INTENT, the residual) + rewrites `flagModel.categories` to the REFERENCE-POINT discriminator (not author) + adds `validation-concern` to the reRunReplaceRule preservation list. ENFORCEMENT (Todo 3 / #154): the Validator now enforces vocabulary (malformed/unknown `@tag` → warning), field shape (required/enum/duplicate), and cardinality — via `MetaTagValidator` reading the compile-time-inlined registry. REMAINDER (#154 follow-up): the family-C extraction-exhaust rules (`run`-required, re-run staleness) + the re-add-detection guard are not yet enforced. Ref schemes (kg:/reef:) are illustrative. Renames go through `aliases`.

carrier.terminator: the `.` goes AFTER the closing backtick: - meta is `...`.
carrier.scopeNote: The `meta` carrier parses on `concept` (metaLine* in conceptBody), `decision` (leading metaLine* in decisionBody), and `library` (trailing metaLine* on libraryStatement) — KE #203 Todo 2 (grammar) + Todo 3/#154 (validator).
carrier.backCompat: A meta line with no leading @tag is a legitimate untyped note and passes validation.

families.A-external-ref: Scored hints to an external store. Candidates are extraction-derived (replace-by-run); confirmed are durable.

ExternalReference.note: Shared shape for the two external-ref tags. KG (Concept Graph) and REEF are DISTINCT stores serving different purposes; both hold scored hints.
ExternalReference.rendering: <display label>; ref <ref>; confidence <0..1>; rank <int>; status <enum>; by <author>

system.source: derived from the tag (@kg-concept -> kg [the Concept Graph, hint for the decision], @reef-reference -> reef [the great REEF, a hint])

ref.note: identifier within the Concept Graph (kg) or REEF (reef)

rank.note: 1-based; 1 = best-ranked candidate. Explicit; NOT inferred from line order.

Origin.rendering: trailing `; by <author>; run <id>; at <iso-timestamp>; source <ref>#<hash>; span <range>; quote <text>`

tags.lifecycleNote: status=candidate entries replaced on re-extraction; status=confirmed entries are durable
tags.notes: Scored HINT FOR THE DECISION — a reference to a node in the Concept Graph ('KG' = Concept Graph). ref scheme `kg:` illustrative.

Semantic parse of the SOURCE narrative (meaning representation). Extraction exhaust.

ref.note: the tracker issue id (e.g. #203) — 'filed' is meaningless without it; a gap-filed WITHOUT a ref is an error

tags.lifecycleNote: DELETE when the CRL no longer depends on the gap. Delete-on-fix is DELIBERATE here (unlike the review flags): the durable record lives in the FILED ISSUE, not inline.

plannedEmit.condition: emit as a CQL block comment — a visible tracked gap, like @business-logic-deferred. Todo 4.

tags.notes: A durable POINTER to a filed gap/issue — NOT a flag (no `flag`, no `warnWhileOpen`, no `status`; does not block mvComplete): a filed gap is managed work that ships fine (like `// TODO(#123)`). Requires `; ref <issue>`. Covers the KE's @stage-boundary case when the gap is FILED; the un-filed 'stage/language can't express this' cases REUSE @crl-future-expression (language limit) / @business-logic-deferred / @clinical-logic-deferred (deferred logic).

validatorRules: value-shape mismatch (e.g. @kg-concept missing ref; confidence outside [0,1]; rank < 1) -> error
cardinality violation (e.g. two @description on one concept) -> error
malformed-tag lint: a meta line starting '@' but not matching ^@[a-z][a-z0-9-]*: -> warning (probable malformed tag — catches silent demotion to an untyped note)
a meta line NOT starting '@' -> legitimate untyped note (back-compat), no diagnostic
re-run staleness: warn if two distinct run ids' family-C / candidate-ref exhaust coexist on one concept
family-C tags and candidate (status=candidate) external refs MUST carry `run` -> error if omitted (otherwise the re-run replace match key is undefined)
@gap-filed without a `ref` -> error (a filed gap needs its issue id)
reRunReplaceRule: On re-extraction, the producer replaces the prior run's family-C tags (semantic-parse-text) and candidate (status=candidate) external refs for a concept, matched by by/run. Confirmed refs and family-B durable tags (id, description, ke-feedback, logic-expression-text, controlled-natural-language, crl-future-expression, business-logic-deferred, clinical-logic-deferred, cql-comment, gap-filed) are never auto-replaced. Refs with status=rejected or status=superseded are durable historical records (preserved across re-runs so negative review work isn't lost). (Review FLAGS left the .crl registry in #212 step 4b — the flag re-add guard now lives with the medical-validation/flags/ store, not here.)
